description: Defines the BulkBusinessEvent class which represents a batch of business events of the same aggregate root, enforcing that all contained events relate to a single aggregate and providing metadata such as type and category.

classes.name: BulkBusinessEvent
classes.description: A class representing a bulk business event consisting of multiple individual business events, with validation to ensure they share the same aggregate root.

methods.name: BulkBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the bulk event with a list of business events and verifies they all share the same aggregate root.

methods.name: verifySameAggregate
methods.description: Private method to ensure all contained business events relate to the same aggregate root ID; throws IllegalArgumentException if not.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the static type identifier for this event class.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category string for these bulk events.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Provides the aggregate root ID of the contained events, assuming all are from the same aggregate.
